title: चतुश्चत्वारिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 144 · Draupadi faints; Ghatotkacha is summoned

summary.en: Unused to walking, Draupadi collapses from exhaustion, and Yudhishthira laments over her. Nakula and the others revive her, and at Yudhishthira's bidding Bhima calls to mind his son Ghatotkacha, who appears at once ready to serve.
summary.kn: ನಡೆದು ಅಭ್ಯಾಸವಿಲ್ಲದ ದ್ರೌಪದಿ ದಣಿವಿನಿಂದ ಕುಸಿಯುತ್ತಾಳೆ, ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನು ವಿಲಪಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ನಕುಲ ಮೊದಲಾದವರು ಅವಳನ್ನು ಎಚ್ಚರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನ ಸೂಚನೆಯಂತೆ ಭೀಮನು ಮಗ ಘಟೋತ್ಕಚನನ್ನು ಸ್ಮರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಅವನು ಕೂಡಲೇ ಸೇವೆಗೆ ಸಿದ್ಧನಾಗಿ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಕ್ಷನಾಗುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: पैदल चलने की अभ्यस्त न होने से द्रौपदी थकान से गिर पड़ती हैं, और युधिष्ठिर विलाप करते हैं। नकुल और अन्य उन्हें होश में लाते हैं, और युधिष्ठिर के कहने पर भीम अपने पुत्र घटोत्कच का स्मरण करते हैं, जो तुरन्त सेवा के लिए प्रकट होता है।
summary.te: నడక అలవాటు లేని ద్రౌపది అలసటతో కుప్పకూలుతుంది, యుధిష్ఠిరుడు విలపిస్తాడు. నకులుడు మొదలైనవారు ఆమెను తేరుకోబెడతారు; యుధిష్ఠిరుని ఆజ్ఞతో భీముడు కుమారుడు ఘటోత్కచుని స్మరిస్తాడు, అతడు వెంటనే సేవకు సిద్ధంగా ప్రత్యక్షమవుతాడు.
summary.ta: நடக்கப் பழகாத திரௌபதி களைப்பால் விழ, யுதிஷ்டிரர் புலம்புகிறார். நகுலன் முதலியோர் அவளை எழுப்ப, யுதிஷ்டிரரின் சொற்படி பீமன் மகன் கடோத்கசனை நினைக்க, அவன் உடனே பணிவிடைக்குத் தயாராகத் தோன்றுகிறான்.
summary.ml: നടക്കാൻ ശീലമില്ലാത്ത ദ്രൗപദി ക്ഷീണംകൊണ്ട് തളർന്നുവീഴുന്നു; യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ അവൾക്കരികെ വിലപിക്കുന്നു. നകുലനും മറ്റുള്ളവരും അവളെ ഉണർത്തുന്നു; യുധിഷ്ഠിരന്റെ കൽപ്പനപ്രകാരം ഭീമൻ തന്റെ പുത്രൻ ഘടോത്കചനെ ഓർക്കുന്നു, അദ്ദേഹം ഉടൻ സേവനത്തിന് സന്നദ്ധനായി പ്രത്യക്ഷപ്പെടുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.144; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
ततः प्रयातमात्रेषु पाण्डवेषु महात्मसु ।
पद्भ्यामनुचिता गन्तुं द्रौपदी समुपाविशत् ॥

meaning.en: Then, just as the great-souled Pandavas had set out, Draupadi, unused to walking, sat down.

verses.text:
श्रान्ता दुःखपरीता च वातवर्षेण तेन च ।
सौकुमार्याच्च पाञ्चाली संमुमोह यशस्विनी ॥

meaning.en: Weary, overcome with distress and by that wind and rain, and delicate, the renowned Panchali fainted.

verses.text:
सा पात्यमाना मोहेन बाहुभ्यामसितेक्षणा ।
वृत्ताभ्यामनुरूपाभ्यामूरू समवलम्बत ॥

meaning.en: As the dark-eyed woman fell in her faintness, she caught at her thighs with her two rounded and shapely arms.

verses.text:
आलम्बमाना सहितावूरू गजकरोपमौ ।
पपात सहसा भूमौ वेपन्ती कदली यथा ॥

meaning.en: Clinging to her thighs, which were like elephants' trunks, she suddenly fell to the ground, trembling like a plantain tree.

verses.text:
तां पतन्तीं वरारोहां सज्जमानां लतामिव ।
नकुलः समभिद्रुत्य परिजग्राह वीर्यवान् ॥

meaning.en: As that lovely-hipped woman fell, like a clinging creeper, mighty Nakula rushed up and caught her.

verses.text: नकुल उवाच

meaning.en: Nakula said:

verses.text:
राजन्पाञ्चालराजस्य सुतेयमसितेक्षणा ।
श्रान्ता निपतिता भूमौ तामवेक्षस्व भारत ॥

meaning.en: King, this dark-eyed daughter of the king of the Panchalas has fallen to the ground, weary. Look at her, Bharata.

verses.text:
अदुःखार्हा परं दुःखं प्राप्तेयं मृदुगामिनी ।
आश्वासय महाराज तामिमां श्रमकर्शिताम् ॥

meaning.en: She, who does not deserve suffering and walks so gently, has met with great suffering. Great king, comfort her, worn out with exhaustion.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
राजा तु वचनात्तस्य भृशं दुःखसमन्वितः ।
भीमश्च सहदेवश्च सहसा समुपाद्रवन् ॥

meaning.en: At his words the king, deeply pained, and Bhima and Sahadeva ran up at once.

verses.text:
तामवेक्ष्य तु कौन्तेयो विवर्णवदनां कृशाम् ।
अङ्कमानीय धर्मात्मा पर्यदेवयदातुरः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing her thin and pale-faced, the righteous son of Kunti took her on his lap and lamented, in distress.

verses.text:
कथं वेश्मसु गुप्तेषु स्वास्तीर्णशयनोचिता ।
शेते निपतिता भूमौ सुखार्हा वरवर्णिनी ॥

meaning.en: "How can she who is used to well-spread beds in sheltered houses, who deserves comfort, lie fallen on the ground, this fair-complexioned woman?"

verses.text:
सुकुमारौ कथं पादौ मुखं च कमलप्रभम् ।
मत्कृतेऽद्य वरार्हायाः श्यामतां समुपागतम् ॥

meaning.en: "How have her delicate feet and her lotus-bright face turned dark today because of me, though she deserves the best?"

verses.text:
किमिदं द्यूतकामेन मया कृतमबुद्धिना ।
आदाय कृष्णां चरता वने मृगगणायुते ॥

meaning.en: "What is this I did in my foolish love of dice, leading Krishna through a forest full of herds of wild beasts?"

verses.text:
सुखं प्राप्स्यति पाञ्चाली पाण्डवान्प्राप्य वै पतीन् ।
इति द्रुपदराजेन पित्रा दत्तायतेक्षणा ॥

meaning.en: "Her father King Drupada gave her, long-eyed, saying, 'The Panchali will find happiness, getting the Pandavas as husbands.'"

verses.text:
तत्सर्वमनवाप्यैव श्रमशोकाद्धि कर्शिता ।
शेते निपतिता भूमौ पापस्य मम कर्मभिः ॥

meaning.en: "Without gaining any of that, she is worn thin by weariness and grief, and lies fallen on the ground because of the deeds of a sinner like me."

verses.text:
तथा लालप्यमाने तु धर्मराजे युधिष्ठिरे ।
धौम्यप्रभृतयः सर्वे तत्राजग्मुर्द्विजोत्तमाः ॥

meaning.en: While Yudhishthira, king of dharma, was lamenting so, Dhaumya and the best of brahmins came there.

verses.text:
ते समाश्वासयामासुराशीर्भिश्चाप्यपूजयन् ।
रक्षोघ्नांश्च तथा मन्त्राञ्जेपुश्चक्रुश्च ते क्रियाः ॥

meaning.en: They comforted her, honoured her with blessings, recited mantras that destroy demons, and performed the rites.

verses.text:
पठ्यमानेषु मन्त्रेषु शान्त्यर्थं परमर्षिभिः ।
स्पृश्यमाना करैः शीतैः पाण्डवैश्च मुहुर्मुहुः ॥

meaning.en: While the great seers recited mantras for peace, and the Pandavas touched her again and again with cool hands,

verses.text:
सेव्यमाना च शीतेन जलमिश्रेण वायुना ।
पाञ्चाली सुखमासाद्य लेभे चेतः शनैः शनैः ॥

meaning.en: and fanned by a cool wind mixed with water, Panchali found relief and slowly regained consciousness.

verses.text:
परिगृह्य च तां दीनां कृष्णामजिनसंस्तरे ।
तदा विश्रामयामासुर्लब्धसंज्ञां तपस्विनीम् ॥

meaning.en: Taking up poor Krishna, they laid her on a bed of antelope skins, and so rested her, the ascetic lady, now conscious.

verses.text:
तस्या यमौ रक्ततलौ पादौ पूजितलक्षणौ ।
कराभ्यां किणजाताभ्यां शनकैः संववाहतुः ॥

meaning.en: The twins gently rubbed her red-soled feet, with their auspicious marks, with their hands, hardened by the bowstring.

verses.text:
पर्याश्वासयदप्येनां धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः ।
उवाच च कुरुश्रेष्ठो भीमसेनमिदं वचः ॥

meaning.en: Yudhishthira, king of dharma, also comforted her, and the best of the Kurus said these words to Bhimasena.

verses.text:
बहवः पर्वता भीम विषमा हिमदुर्गमाः ।
तेषु कृष्णा महाबाहो कथं नु विचरिष्यति ॥

meaning.en: Bhima, there are many uneven, snow-bound mountains. Mighty-armed one, how will Krishna manage on them?

verses.text: भीमसेन उवाच

meaning.en: Bhimasena said:

verses.text:
त्वां राजन्राजपुत्रीं च यमौ च पुरुषर्षभौ ।
स्वयं नेष्यामि राजेन्द्र मा विषादे मनः कृथाः ॥

meaning.en: King, I myself will carry you, the princess, and the twins, bulls among men. Do not let your mind fall into despair.

verses.text:
अथ वासौ मया जातो विहगो मद्बलोपमः ।
वहेदनघ सर्वान्नो वचनात्ते घटोत्कचः ॥

meaning.en: Or else, blameless one, let the son born to me, Ghatotkacha, a bird-like being as strong as I, carry us all at your word.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
अनुज्ञातो धर्मराज्ञा पुत्रं सस्मार राक्षसम् ।
घटोत्कचश्च धर्मात्मा स्मृतमात्रः पितुस्तदा ।
कृताञ्जलिरुपातिष्ठदभिवाद्याथ पाण्डवान् ॥

meaning.en: With the king of dharma's leave, Bhima remembered his demon son. And the righteous Ghatotkacha, as soon as his father thought of him, appeared with joined hands, having saluted the Pandavas.

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणांश्च महाबाहुः स च तैरभिनन्दितः ।
उवाच भीमसेनं स पितरं सत्यविक्रमः ॥

meaning.en: The mighty-armed one, true to his word, was welcomed by the brahmins too, and said to his father Bhimasena:

verses.text:
स्मृतोऽस्मि भवता शीघ्रं शुश्रूषुरहमागतः ।
आज्ञापय महाबाहो सर्वं कर्तास्म्यसंशयम् ।
तच्छ्रुत्वा भीमसेनस्तु राक्षसं परिषस्वजे ॥

meaning.en: "I have come quickly, called to mind by you, wishing to serve. Command me, mighty-armed one; I shall do everything without doubt." Hearing this, Bhimasena embraced the demon.
